wooter.name: Wooter
wooter.type: Custom team uniforms and apparel, made to order
wooter.what: Fully custom jerseys, uniforms and team apparel for basketball, football, flag football and 7v7, soccer, baseball, softball, volleyball, lacrosse, cheer, tennis and wrestling. Start from 500+ styles in the online builder and change the colors, logo, team name and roster with a live preview, or have Wooter's designers do it at no charge.
wooter.fit: Teams, leagues, schools and coaches who want a full matching set designed and ordered in one place.
wooter.pricing: Every product page lists its price by quantity, and the price per piece drops as the order grows. Most products have a minimum of one. Design is free and you pay only when you order.
wooter.turnaround: Designs in 1 to 2 business days. Three weeks on average from design approval to delivery. Rush turnaround in one to two weeks costs extra.
wooter.pick: Design it free, see the price as you build, order the whole set in one place.
wooter.proof: 18,000+ teams, 100,000+ athletes and 2,000+ five-star reviews, per wooter.com.
wooter.open_questions: Lead time averages three weeks, with rush in one to two weeks at extra cost, and pricing is by quantity on each product page. All confirmed by Alex on 2026-11-19. wooter.com still shows 2 to 3, two to four and 3 to 4 weeks in places, which the Wooter team may want to align.

boombah.name: Boombah
boombah.type: Sublimated custom uniforms, direct from the maker
boombah.what: Boombah makes fully sublimated custom uniforms to order in its own factories and sells them direct through online builders. Its range is deepest in baseball and fastpitch, with basketball and volleyball alongside.
boombah.fit: Teams that want to build a sublimated uniform online and buy straight from the maker.
boombah.pricing: Priced per garment with quantity breaks. Its sublimation pages advertise no setup fees, no design fees and no minimum.
boombah.turnaround: Its pages quote a two week or three week standard lead time depending on the product, with rush for a fee.

customink.name: Custom Ink
customink.what: Custom Ink decorates a large catalog of stock apparel, team jerseys included, with your design, names and numbers. A group order form lets each player pick a size, and product experts are available seven days a week.
customink.fit: Small groups that want a printed jersey quickly and without a large minimum.
customink.pricing: Per-item pricing that falls as quantity rises. Standard shipping is free.
customink.turnaround: About two weeks standard, with rush options at extra cost.

champro.name: Champro
champro.what: Champro's Juice line is cut-and-sew, fully sublimated uniforms, and Splash is a lower-cost sublimation on finished garments. Designs are made in its Uniform Builder and orders go in through a Champro dealer account.
champro.fit: Programs that already buy through a local team dealer.
champro.pricing: Set by the dealer. No public price list on the builder.
champro.turnaround: Lead times vary with order volume and are confirmed after artwork approval.

niketeam.name: Nike Team
niketeam.type: Uniforms sold through authorized Nike dealers
niketeam.what: Nike Team offers build-to-order uniforms designed in its online builder and placed through an authorized Nike Team dealer, plus stock uniforms that can be personalized with names, numbers or artwork.
niketeam.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and have a dealer relationship.
niketeam.turnaround: Build-to-order uniforms deliver in 30, 60 or 90 days. Personalized stock uniforms arrive within three weeks.

varsityspirit.name: Varsity Spirit
varsityspirit.type: Cheer uniforms ordered through a local rep
varsityspirit.what: Varsity Spirit has made cheer uniforms since 1979, for school and All Star programs. A local Varsity rep guides the order, helps design the uniform and sizes the athletes in person.
varsityspirit.fit: School and All Star programs that want a rep to run the process.
varsityspirit.pricing: Quoted through your rep. There is no public checkout for custom uniforms.
varsityspirit.turnaround: Set with your rep once the design and sizing are done.

omnicheer.name: Chassé at Omni Cheer
omnicheer.type: Cheer uniforms with an online design studio
omnicheer.what: Omni Cheer sells Chassé uniforms: in-stock shells and skirts that ship ready to wear, and sublimated uniforms you build in its online design studio.
omnicheer.fit: Squads that want stock uniforms fast or a sublimated set designed online.
omnicheer.pricing: Prices are on each product page. Sublimated pieces carry a minimum quantity of six.
omnicheer.turnaround: Its customization page lists 4 to 6 weeks for sublimation and 3 to 4 weeks for lettering on stock uniforms.

flyathletics.name: Fly Athletics
flyathletics.type: Custom cheer uniforms for All Star and school teams
flyathletics.what: Fly Athletics makes fully custom cheer uniforms, from fabric and colors to rhinestone patterns and stitching, and has a cheer design app.
flyathletics.fit: Gyms that want a couture competition look.
flyathletics.pricing: Quoted per design. A minimum of six uniforms per design, with no minimum on reorders.
flyathletics.turnaround: First designs in 24 to 48 hours. Production in six to eight weeks.

cliffkeen.name: Cliff Keen
cliffkeen.type: Wrestling singlets made in Ann Arbor, Michigan
cliffkeen.what: Cliff Keen builds custom sublimated singlets from templates in its uniform builder, in men's, women's and international cuts. All of its singlets are produced in Ann Arbor, Michigan.
cliffkeen.fit: Wrestling programs that want a specialist.
cliffkeen.pricing: Singlet templates list from $84.50 to $98.50, with a minimum order of six on most custom products.
cliffkeen.turnaround: Orders usually ship within 3 to 5 weeks of final art approval. Some product pages estimate 4 to 6.

allsports.name: All Sports Uniforms
allsports.type: DAWG wrestling singlets with an online builder
allsports.what: All Sports Uniforms sells DAWG sublimated singlets, women's singlets, rashguards, fight shorts and warmups, designed in its Wrestling Uniform Builder or from your own artwork.
allsports.fit: Clubs and schools that want a builder and a rush option.
allsports.pricing: Quoted by order. Orders of one to six women's singlets carry a $20 per-singlet fee, and reorders have no minimum.
allsports.turnaround: Standard production is three weeks, with one and two week rush.

jostens.name: Jostens
jostens.what: Jostens sells letter jackets through an online builder that walks you through each step, with more than 100 patches for sports and activities.
jostens.pricing: A base letterman jacket starts around $200. Patches, embroidery and leather sleeves are priced as add-ons.

rushordertees.name: RushOrderTees
rushordertees.type: Printed and embroidered jackets on stock styles
rushordertees.what: RushOrderTees decorates stock letterman and varsity jackets from brands like Sport-Tek and Augusta Sportswear with your print or embroidery, designed in its online studio.
rushordertees.fit: Groups that want a logo on a ready-made jacket.
rushordertees.pricing: Volume pricing is shown per style. No minimum for printed jackets and six pieces for most embroidery.
